variants.headline: Still in view: party leader blunders in election debate
variants.sub: An election debate has included a blunder by {leader}, leader of {party}.
variants.body:
The leader of {party}, {leader}, has blundered in an election debate. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

The gazette records the debate blunder without reproducing words not supplied to this notice. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
